{{Top|leg}}
A '''turbolaser actuator''' was a weapons component used in [[Loronar Defense Industries]]' [[MAS-2xB]] as part of the [[turbolaser pulsor]]. The actuator was surrounded by an [[amplification dish]] that was used to focus the weapon's energy beam. A turbolaser actuator was also part of the [[w-165 planetary turbolaser]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
